home.title: Jụọ maka iwu Naịjirịa.
home.intro: Jụọ ya otú i si ekwu okwu. Ị ga-enweta azịza doro anya na nkebi ndị ahụ ọ si na ha.
home.paused: Nkọwa akwụsịla nwa oge. Chọta nkebi ka ị gaa n'ihu na-agụ iwu e bipụtara.
suggestions: Ndị uwe ojii nwere ike inyocha ekwentị m?
Ogologo oge ole ka ndị uwe ojii nwere ike ijide m tupu ha akpọga m n'ụlọikpe?
Onye nwere ike ịgba ọsọ maka onye isi ala?
home.disclaimer: Azịza na-akọwa iwu e bipụtara n'asụsụ dị mfe, ha nwekwara ike ịhapụ ụfọdụ nkọwa. Lelee nkebi ha jikọrọ, ma soro ọkàiwu kparịta maka okwu gị.

outcome.clarification_required: Ajụjụ ahụ metụtara ọtụtụ ihe n'otu oge. Nwaa ịjụ maka otu iwu, otu nkebi ma ọ bụ otu okwu.
outcome.validation_failed: Anyị enweghị ike ikwenye na nkọwa ahụ dabara na ndokwa e bipụtara, ya mere nkebi ndị ahụ n'onwe ha nọ ebe a.
outcome.provider_failure: Nkọwa adịghị ugbu a. Nkebi e bipụtara metụtara ya nọ ebe a.
outcome.budget_exhausted: Anyị eruola oke nkọwa maka taa. Nkebi e bipụtara metụtara ya nọ ebe a.
outcome.capacity_exhausted: Ọtụtụ mmadụ na-ajụ ajụjụ ugbu a. Ederede metụtara ya nọ ebe a; nwaa ọzọ mgbe otu nkeji gachara.
outcome.closest: Ọ dị ka ndokwa e bipụtara anaghị aza nke a ozugbo. Nkebi kacha nso anyị hụrụ nọ ebe a.
outcome.noSection: Anyị ahụghị nkebi e bipụtara na-aza nke a. Nwaa ịjụ ya n'ụzọ ọzọ, ma ọ bụ kpọọ aha iwu na nkebi.
outcome.unfinished: Anyị enweghị ike imecha azịza a. Nkebi e bipụtara metụtara ya nọ ebe a.

errors.unavailable: Nkọwa adịghị nwa oge. Ajụjụ gị ka nọ ebe a; nwaa ọzọ ma ọ bụ chọta nkebi metụtara ya.

errors.sendFailed: Ihe mebiri mgbe a na-eziga ajụjụ gị. Lelee njikọ gị ma nwaa ọzọ.
